data.gender_notes: Emerencia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'emergere' meaning 'to arise', this name signifies help or rescue. In Christian tradition, Emerencia is a female name associated with Saint Emerentiana, a martyr who was discovered and rescued from a well by a hunter named Maurus. The name Emerencia carries the meaning “Emergency help” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Emerencia usually hope their child will grow to embody emergency help and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emerencia total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
